title: Remembering Bunk Johnson through his father; starting at nineteen
summary: Russ was too young to remember Bunk Johnson; he started playing professionally at nineteen.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Do you remember Bonk, by the way?
No, I remember Bonk. That's when my daddy used to do it.
Yeah, but you remember him at that time?
Not at that time. My daddy was playing with him. I was a kid.
I was a monk at Packley, quit playing. When I started out in music, I mean when I got families. How old were you when you started playing? I was nineteen years old.
